content:
MulAntidiagonal.lean exports the set-based Finset antidiagonal name that blocks the planned HasMulAntidiagonal.mulAntidiagonal export in Prod.lean.

I’d like to know which path is preferred: consistently rename the set-based Finset API on both sides, so Finset.mulAntidiagonal becomes Finset.setMulAntidiagonal and Finset.addAntidiagonal becomes Finset.setAddAntidiagonal. This rename trickles downstream; or asymmetrically rename only the multiplicative set-based API to Finset.setMulAntidiagonal, while leaving the additive API as Finset.addAntidiagonal.

Either way, I need to free up the name Finset.mulAntidiagonal so this line of code will not trigger errors in mathlib's global build check after the TODO is in place

export HasMulAntidiagonal (mulAntidiagonal mem_mulAntidiagonal)
